subject: STABLE render-lead-opus C6s-expand: mid-command reaps wait only for GPU WRITERS of CPU-read buffers; gate-green; HEAVY RELEASE
body:
C6r device: mid_reaps=410, 381 from index re-expansion. The B2 targeted wait listed the index, vertex-source and arena buffers and waited for every queued job that LISTED them - CA's index/vertex buffers are read by most queued draws, and the per-encoder expand arena is read by the earlier draws of the same command (other ranges).
FIX: bridge recent[] keeps each job's write mask; new n2mb_wait_handles_written (header N2MB_HAVE_WAIT_WRITTEN) waits only for queued jobs that WRITE one of the handles (and flushes an open chain only if it writes one). compute_frontend.m mid-reap: CPU-read buffers (blit source, re-expansion index+source) -> written-only wait; CPU-written buffer (blit/preclear destination) -> the old any-lister wait; the re-expansion's own arena range is unsubmitted and disjoint from earlier jobs' ranges (an arena is per encoder, and a pooled arena BO is reused only after its last job is reaped), so it adds no wait. Batch members were already re-expanded without a wait.
Evidence: bridge test (async model): after a queued draw sampling t and writing r, wait_written(t) = no WAIT_SEQ, wait_written(r) = one. Host frame_bench scenarios have no mid reaps (no re-expansion in its batched CA loop), so no frame_bench number for this one; device TEGU_PERF_ASYNC mid=a/b/c/d should show b (expand) ~0 and mid_waits drop.
GATES: run_host_tests all passed (ARM64 + strict link); texture_format PASS; CA PF0/PF1 PASS; render harness PASS; async 7/7; integration = known CA 66/42 only.
